profile.name: SAYALI SANJAY SONAWANE
profile.title: Cybersecurity, GRC & Technology Audit
profile.bio: CISA-certified technology risk and compliance professional working across cybersecurity, governance and risk management, and audit automation. Experience spans IT general controls, application and cloud security reviews, vulnerability management, and regulatory frameworks including SOX, PCI DSS, NIST, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, across financial services and enterprise environments. I pair control testing with SQL, data analytics and AI-driven automation to cut manual review effort and move findings to closure faster.
